decisions.reason: The temporary work gate does not resolve the existing script-versus-storyboard ambiguity or change the required conformance behavior; it is already represented by the source clarification-process Requirement.
Pausing further work pending the client's change list does not alter the approved image-quality methods or requirements.
The source imposes a general temporary work gate but does not change the established CC1 framing sequence or any of its attributes.
The opening aerial shot was already deferred, and the source neither changes its inclusion nor adds a distinct requirement-state change.
